wiki.title: Wayne Clark (politician)
wiki.extract: Wayne Clark (born February 16, 1972) is an American politician who represents District 99 in the West Virginia House of Delegates as a Republican. He has been serving in that position since December 1, 2022. He has previously served as the member for the 65th district for 1 2-year term, from 2020 to 2022.
